name: Payment to new payee under apparent time pressure
description: Victim-side: a first payment of unusually high value to a newly created payee, made quickly after a phone call or message and often outside normal patterns.
fp: Genuine house purchases, one-off large bills or planned gifts to new payees.

sources.text: UK Finance, Annual Fraud Report (specify year, e.g. 2025)
